title: Live Animal Pricing Bulletin: Discounts, Pals Rewards Points and Certificates
content:
Prices of live animals sold with the Live Pet Health Guarantee carry the following discounts and Pals Rewards treatment, set per guarantee type.

## Discounts

| Guarantee type | Discount on a habitat starter kit bought with the animal | Discount on the animal for an active Tailwise Plus tier | Multi-animal discount (several animals of the same species bought at once) | Animals needed for the multi-animal discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | 10% | 0% | 10% | 6 |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | 10% | 0% | 5% | 4 |
| Live Coral Guarantee | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0 (no multi-animal discount) |
| Small Animal Guarantee | 15% | 0% | 0% | 0 (no multi-animal discount) |
| Bird Guarantee | 15% | 0% | 0% | 0 (no multi-animal discount) |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | 15% | 0% | 0% | 0 (no multi-animal discount) |

## Pals Rewards

| Guarantee type | Multiplier on the Pals Rewards base earn rate for the live animal purchase | Pals Rewards certificates usable on the animal |
|---|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | 0 | No |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | 0 | No |
| Live Coral Guarantee | 0 | No |
| Small Animal Guarantee | 0 | No |
| Bird Guarantee | 0 | No |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | 0 | No |

## Notes to the bulletin

1. A multiplier of 0 on the base earn rate means a live animal purchase earns no Pals Rewards points under any guarantee type.
2. An active Tailwise Plus tier brings a discount of 0% on the animal under every guarantee type.
3. Multi-animal discount thresholds, both sides: a freshwater fish purchase of 6 animals of the same species reaches the 6-animal figure and takes 10%, while 5 does not; a saltwater purchase of 4 animals of the same species takes 5%, while 3 does not.
4. Hypothetical starter kit: a starter kit priced 100.00 USD bought with a bird is discounted by 15%, to 85.00 USD; bought with live coral it carries no discount.
